summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Amana Growth ETF (AMGR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively invests in stocks globally that are consistent with Islamic principles, according to the adviser. The ETF seeks to provide a diversified portfolio, positioned for long-term capital growth AMGR was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Amana.

holdings.infoBox: AMGR is an equity ETF with a total of 31 individual holdings. The top holdings are Apple stock at 8.22%, NVIDIA at 7.18%, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company at 7.13%, Alphabet at 6.83%, and ASML Holding at 6.44%.
